findings.title: Existing PW compact source-name prefix is not fully readable
findings.trigger: Twenty-five fixed sources include configured-00 and configured-01 with owner-declared compact names Configu…00…rce name and Configu…01…rce name in the 168-pixel native source frames.
findings.observed_failure: In all three actual original frames, further elision replaces part of the compact prefix; residual letters, the full digits and rce name remain visible. Selected 00 and held 01 therefore satisfy identity and inverse-color checks but cannot receive complete compact-name credit.
findings.requested_resolution: Resolve the existing compact-name readability item within the current PW shortcut contract and provide fresh owner captures for any changed freeze. Preserve the passing two-digit identities, selection and held inverse, border geometry, draft, caption and keyboard.
findings.cause_and_novelty_limit: The frozen images establish the visible failure only. This reviewer did not inspect production code or older candidates and does not claim that Candidate12 introduced a regression.
